Well, the only Negro band that I can remember in a bar was the Tom Anderson bar on Iberville. I think it was Iberville and Basin Street. They usually had a three or four piece Negro band in there.

I understand they had a string band sometimes. Do you remember if they were mostly things like... I don't remember the piano with them at all. I mean, I could have been, but I don't recall that. Usually I think they used a bass and a guitar maybe...
Bass, guitar, and maybe a sax.
That's that one period they used a mandolin. I've seen a picture of a group that played there... Well... ...way back in...
I don't actually remember the instruments used, but I remember they did have a band on occasion in that bar. Particularly I think on Saturday nights.
Yes. And you mentioned that you never heard any bands in the... In any of the... In any of the...

The houses. In a better class house. No bands. Always a piano player came in and each one contributed to him as they went out. Yes. And... The only Negro bands I can never recall were the Negro dance hall, wherever they might have been down there.
Yes. There was one called the Tuxedo dance hall. I remember that. And the Entertainers or 101 Ranch. Do you remember any of those?
No, I remember Tuxedo, but I don't remember 101 Ranch.

It was across the street, right in back of Tom Anderson's. Oh, it was. Sort of in back of... Between Lila White and Tom Anderson's in that block. Oh, yes. But... Well, I don't know. On Franklin Street. No. Do you remember the piano players, if they were mostly colored or white? Both. Both. Both. White and Tom Anderson's in that block. Both were used. Yes. And you never heard any other instruments except the pianos and... That is all.

Now, at carnival time, it was a custom for the people of New Orleans, when there were mass, to go down to those houses. Yeah. Very nice people. Me and the man and the wife would go down and see what it looked like. Of course, they were mass, and they usually had a band of some kind at that time, you see. But I don't remember whether it was jazz bands or some other kind of bands or dancing.
